title: A test that sandboxes HOME still reaches a live intentd where XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set: daemon_commands.bats's absent arms go red on a host running intentd
body:
**A TEST THAT SANDBOXES `$HOME` STILL REACHES A LIVE `intentd` WHERE `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` IS SET.** Found by dc's second kovacs rehearsal for the 3.4.0 cut, at aac6acbef on 2026-11-17, whose only reds were three arms of `tests/unit/daemon_commands.bats`: 155 (`daemon status: reports absent at rc=0 when nothing is running`), 156 (`daemon status --format json: the machine face is a bare lowercase discriminator`) and 163 (`daemon status: a leftover socket FILE with no listener is still absent`).

**The mechanism, read and not inferred.** The file's setup points `$HOME` at a scratch directory, and its header says that relocates the address the CLI probes "by construction". That stopped being true when the user directories took their XDG inputs: `intentsvcs::userstate::Dirs::resolve` puts the daemon's socket under `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/intent` when that variable is set, and under `<state>/run` only otherwise, with `<state>` itself `$XDG_STATE_HOME/intent` before `$HOME/.local/state/intent`. A Linux login session sets `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`. On kovacs it is `/run/user/1002`, and a Homebrew 3.3.3 `intentd` (pid 1718038, up since 2026-11-16) listens at `/run/user/1002/intent/intentd.sock`. So under the leg, `daemon status` found that daemon and did not report absent. No daemon was running there at the 3.3.3 cut's leg on 2026-11-15, where these arms passed, and nothing in `daemon.rs` or `userstate.rs` has changed since. It is a test-isolation gap that the host's state exposes, not a product regression. The file runs only `status`, help and refusals, so the live daemon was probed and never stopped.

**The same gap in the shared helper.** `setup_fake_home` (`tests/lib/test_helper.bash`) moves `$HOME` and nothing else, so any test under it resolves Intent's config, data, state and runtime directories from whichever `XDG_*` variables the shell exports, outside the sandbox. None is set on rhadamanth today, and on kovacs only `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` is, so the other three are latent. `release_preflight.bats` and `release_preflight_seam.bats` also ask about a daemon, but through a stub `intent`, so they do not reach a real one.

**The fix.** One helper in `tests/lib/test_helper.bash` unsets the four `XDG_*` variables `userstate.rs` reads, so a sandboxed `$HOME` decides every user directory Intent derives. `setup_fake_home` calls it, and so does `daemon_commands.bats`'s own setup, which keeps its short `$HOME` for the socket path's length limit. The file's header says what isolates the address. A test that wants an XDG variable exports it after the sandbox, as `devbin_own_switch_and_publish.bats` already does.

**Proof.** The red is rehearsal 2's own record, on the host that showed the gap. The green is rehearsal 3 at the landed HEAD, with kovacs's daemon left running (vc, 2026-11-17). Whether a brew `intentd` should run on kovacs at all is hv's to say. Owner: dc. It rides the 3.4.0 release.
